hotels.title: Palatial Raffles Udaipur Lakeside Luxury in Rajasthan’s Romantic City
hotels.description: Set on a private island in Udai Sagar Lake, this palatial retreat brings Rajasthani grandeur to life with marble pavilions, ornate archways and sweeping views across the Aravalli Hills. The City Palace and Jagdish Temple are within easy reach in Udaipur, where carved facades, courtyards and centuries-old artistry reveal the city’s regal heritage. Days here drift between the lakefront pool, serene spa rituals and refined dining inspired by regional Indian flavours and global cuisine. Beyond the water, guests can visit Saheliyon-ki-Bari’s lotus pools and fountains or dine at Ambrai, famed for its candlelit setting overlooking Lake Pichola
